definite_Source_costs.name: CodeType dictionary hashing
definite_Source_costs.fact: On every main-thread profile event the current code is used for membership and indexing before any event-specific branch. CPython v3.12.10 code_hash hashes the constant/name/table fields and loops over the instruction stream through Py_SIZE(co), skipping inline caches. It does not cache its final hash.

definite_Source_costs.name: Frame ancestry and filename normalization
definite_Source_costs.fact: Every rouge Python call walks origin ancestry before the targeted-capture test; exception tracing separately normalizes filenames.

definite_Source_costs.name: Full independent native snapshots
definite_Source_costs.fact: Each snapshot builds native graph, inverses it, rebuilds and asserts equality; caller before, caller after, and return are independent evidence captures.

definite_Source_costs.name: Cumulative checkpoint totals/index
definite_Source_costs.fact: Each checkpoint scans every existing chunk twice for totals and serializes/atomically publishes the full cumulative index.

definite_Source_costs.name: Full payload encoding/compression/hash
definite_Source_costs.fact: Each materialized payload is encoded, gzip-compressed and hashed in compressed/decoded forms with profiling/tracing restored to their prior hooks during file work.
